tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Defining specific factory inspection requirements before the unit leaves the factory.
Detailing safety & insurance parameters during the transit/unloading phase at the municipal site.
Outlining clear terms for the supply of an initial diesel fuel charge for testing/commissioning logs.

Structured a highly secure 3-stage breakdown (70% upon safe delivery at Ranebennur, 20% after structural testing & electrical commissioning, and 10% after operational handover and warranty registration validation).

Core specifications for a 50 KW (62.5 kVA) prime-rated DG set (covering CPCB emission standards, acoustic canopy insulation, fuel capacity) and detailed panel configurations (IP55 protection, AMF controller, switchgear interlocking).

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
The contractors assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as per the clause 3.6 of STD tender document Attached
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act
Further Particulars if any required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the CMC Municipal Commissioner during office hours on all working days
The Municipal Commissioner reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
LOA/LOI will be Issued In Online to Selected Bidder and bidder Should Accept the LOA/LOI and Others and Submit the Require Documents Regarding Tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Work Completion Certificate showing a single work order of 4.10 Lakhs.

Calibrated the single work experience criterion to Rs.4.10 Lakhs (50% of 8.20 Lakh). Bidders must have successfully executed a project of this scale involving a minimum 50 KW DG set and control panel board for a government body/ULB within the past 3 years.
Valid Class-1 Electrical License issued by Govt of Karnataka/Authorized dealership owner
